 ATP Basel Day 4 Predictions Including Novak Djokovic vs Jan-Lennard Struff 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 This week’s ATP 500 event in Basel has an absoltely stacked draw and day 4 will provide plenty of incredible matchups, with several ATP Finals contenders in action and desperate for points to secure their spot in Turin . Novak Djokovic will be the biggest name in action, of course, but there will be plenty of other exciting matches to watch all throughout the day.
 ATP Basel Day 4 Predictions
 Valentin Vacherot vs Rafael Jodar
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 After a few bad tournaments, especially the US Open , Jodar seems to have found a second wind in Shanghai and he once again showed a very good level in the first round here. He’s very close to a spot in Turin and a deep run here would put him really close to that goal. While Vacherot can be a difficult opponent on a fast indoor court if Jodar can maintain the level he has been showing in recent weeks he should have the edge here.
 Prediction: Jodar in 3
 Taylor Fritz vs Denis Shapovalov
 Head-to-head: Shapovalov 6-5 Fritz
 Shapovalov has had quite a lot of success in this matchup and he certainly has the game to beat Fritz here, but the American will be especially desperate for points as only a truly deep run here can keep him in contention for Turin. On a surface like this, Fritz should be extremely hard to break while Shapovalov tends to have some lapses on his own serve.
 Prediction: Fritz in 3
 Aug 21, 2026; Mason, OH, USA; Taylor Fritz (USA) reacts after returning a shot against Ben Nakashima (USA) during the Cincinnati Open at Lindner Family Tennis Center. Mandatory Credit: Aaron Doster-Imagn Images 
 Novak Djokovic vs Jan-Lennard Struff
 Head-to-head: Djokovic 8-0 Struff
 Djokovic has completely dominated this match, not only winning all eight matches but 20 out of 21 sets they played. Struff has been playing very well indoors, but Djokovic seems locked in and determined to book his spot in Turin so he is highly unlikely to get a first win in this matchup here, even if he could make the sets close with his serve.
 Prediction: Djokovic in 2
